# Test fixtures

Only small, redistributable synthetic fixtures may be committed here. Do not commit copyrighted books, real voice samples without permission, or generated full-length audio.

## EPUB spike fixtures

`epub/synthetic-complex` and `epub/synthetic-malformed` contain original synthetic text created
for this project and dedicated for unrestricted test use. Their `.epub` siblings are deterministic
archives generated by:

```sh
pnpm --filter @light-novel-audiobook/epub-spike build:fixtures
```

The fixture story, names, metadata, SVG, and UUID are fictional and are not excerpts from a book.
